name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly after a career in retail management. He found himself drawn to the fast-paced, high-stakes environment and saw an opportunity to apply his organizational and people skills. He transitioned into motorsport HR, initially focusing on recruitment for smaller racing teams. Ricardo believes in building a strong team culture and fostering employee development, even in the demanding world of motorsport. He aims to ensure every member feels valued and has opportunities to grow, ultimately leading to better team performance and a more positive work environment.

While relatively new to the upper echelons of motorsport HR, Ricardo is a quick learner and dedicated to mastering the intricacies of talent management within this specialized field. He is particularly interested in optimizing team dynamics and identifying hidden potential within existing staff. Ricardo has a firm but fair approach, emphasizing clear communication and accountability to ensure that all team members are operating at their best. He constantly seeks out new approaches and data-driven methods for improving HR efficiency and employee satisfaction.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height, with a somewhat serious demeanor and a thoughtful gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook for jotting down observations about staff interactions.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when reviewing performance reports.
Insists on starting every meeting exactly on time, regardless of attendees' arrival status.
